channel.title: Kyle McCool
channel.description: Personal site of Kyle McCool, Co-Founder and Director of Operations | Head of Growth at Makko AI. Co-founder of Phantomline and ProLocalBuilder. Based in Appleton, Wisconsin.

item.title: Kyle McCool, Co-Founder and Director of Operations | Head of Growth at Makko AI
item.description: Co-Founder and Director of Operations | Head of Growth at Makko AI, an AI-powered 2D game studio SaaS. Built the early prototype with Tony Valcarcel. Built most of Phantomline and ProLocalBuilder. Contributed to the largest NFT mint in OpenSea history at 220,000 assets during four years at Moonray PBC. Technical SEO, AEO, AI workflows. Based in Appleton, Wisconsin.

item.title: Makko AI, Kyle McCool's role as Co-Founder and Director of Operations | Head of Growth
item.description: Kyle McCool's deep page on his work at Makko AI. SEO and AEO Master Playbook, AI citations strategy, Product Hunt launch leadership, backlink profile, and the original prototype built with Tony Valcarcel.

item.title: Phantomline, the local-first AI video studio Kyle McCool built with Cesar Martinez and Zac Dillard
item.description: Kyle McCool wrote most of Phantomline, a local-first AI video studio for faceless YouTube creators. Flask backend with Ollama, Kokoro TTS, MusicGen, and ffmpeg. Co-founded with Cesar Martinez and Zac Dillard.

item.title: ProLocalBuilder, the flat-fee web design platform Kyle McCool built with Cesar Martinez and Zac Dillard
item.description: Kyle McCool wrote most of ProLocalBuilder, a flat-fee web design platform for local service businesses. One builder per metro: Kyle runs Fox Valley WI, Cesar runs the San Francisco Bay Area, Zac runs Las Vegas.

item.title: Moonray PBC, Kyle McCool's Web3 marketing work (2021 to 2025)
item.description: Kyle McCool spent four years at Moonray PBC as Marketing Manager, scaling community to 170,000+ followers and contributing to the largest NFT mint in OpenSea history at 220,000 assets.

item.title: Writing by Kyle McCool
item.description: Essays by Kyle McCool on AI tooling, SEO and AEO at low domain rating, Web3 marketing lessons, and founder-operator work. Published first on the Makko AI blog (Ghost CMS) with cross-posts to Medium, Dev.to, and Hashnode.
